subject: Trial playbook: success criteria, ownership, timeline — next steps
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>
To: Asha Rao <asha@brightwire.com>; Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@brightwire.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_k@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Mar 2026 15:08:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up + trial playbook (BrightWire) — quick summary and next steps

Thanks again for taking the time today — really appreciate the honest roadmap of your evaluation priorities. As promised, here’s a short recap and a proposed trial playbook so we can get the evaluation moving this week.

Recap (from our call)
- Primary goal: validate latency and cost at 95th percentile for your ingest + rerank pipeline (approx. 500 concurrent sessions).
- Secondary: confirm model parity for retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) prompts vs. your current in-house model.
- Constraints: strict network egress rules, SOC2 evidence, and a 2-week trial window.

Proposed trial playbook (high-level) — target timeline: 2 weeks
1) Day 0 (this week): signed MOA and network allowlist. (Action: BrightWire IT)
2) Day 1–2: private trial deployment (dedicated pool) + test harness upload. (Action: Redwood infra + BrightWire eval)
3) Day 3–8: run synthetic load + 3x representative customer prompts. Capture latency, token cost, and qualitative responses. (Action: BrightWire eval)
4) Day 9–12: shared evaluation session; review quality deltas and unit economics. (Action: Sales + Eng)
5) Day 13–14: decision review and next-steps (canary rollout, contract). (Action: BrightWire + Redwood)

Success criteria (we should confirm these formally)
- 95th percentile end-to-end latency < 350ms for 512-token requests under sustained 500 concurrent sessions
- Token cost no more than 30% higher than your current baseline for equal quality
- F1/ROUGE metrics for core rerank prompts within 3% of baseline (or equivalent qualitative parity)

Attachments I attached: trial-acceptance-criteria.xlsx (tabbed checklist), network-topology.png (sample allowlist), redwood-moa-draft.pdf (MOA for signature).

Next steps I propose:
- Asha: confirm who will sign MOA and provide a target sign date by EOD Friday.
- Tom: confirm test-harness upload location and a short list (3) of canonical prompts.
- Rachel/Vivek: we’ll provision the private trial and share access details once MOA is in place.

If any of the success criteria are off-target, tell me and we’ll refine before we kick off.

Thanks — Priyom

--
Priyom Das
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
priyom@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0199
From: Asha Rao <asha@brightwire.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@brightwire.com>, BrightWire Evaluation Team <eval@brightwire.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 13 Mar 2026 09:16:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up + trial playbook (BrightWire) — quick summary and next steps

Hi Priyom — thanks for the clear plan. Team is aligned; a few notes and confirmations below.

Quick confirmations
- We can sign the MOA this week. Legal wants to review the redlined item on data retention (I’ve asked them to keep it to 24 hours if possible). Target: sign by Mon 16 Mar EOD.
- Test harness: Tom will upload the harness to the Drive folder you shared and will add three canonical prompt sets (search, rerank, and chat sample). Expect upload by Mon afternoon.
- Network: I’m looping in our infra team — we’ll provide the allowlist and the contact for firewall changes (see contact in the header from Tom).

A couple of asks from our side
1) Can Redwood enable per-route tracing for the trial so we can correlate token-level cost to specific rerank calls? We need this for our internal cost model.
2) Can you add a brief readme in the Drive with the exact API call examples and sample curl requests? That helps our devs onboard faster.

Tom, adding you to own the test harness upload.

Thanks,
Asha

--
Asha Rao
Head of Product Operations | BrightWire Analytics
asha@brightwire.com
From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>
To: Asha Rao <asha@brightwire.com>, Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@brightwire.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_k@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 16 Mar 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up + trial playbook (BrightWire) — provisioning details + ownership

Thanks Asha — great. Quick updates from our side and answers to your asks: 

Provisioning status
- MOA: received the signed copy at 09:42 this morning (thanks legal teams). I’ve uploaded the executed MOA to the HubSpot record and Drive (link in metadata).
- Private trial: infra will provision a dedicated pool in us-west-2 tonight. You’ll get credentials and an allowlist ip:port set once provisioning finishes. (Action owners: Vivek infra lead; Rachel will confirm access.)

Responses to asks
- Per-route tracing: yes — we can enable per-route token breakdown and attach a short CSV of per-call token counts. This will appear in the Console under the trial model route; Rachel will share the trace sample.
- Readme / onboarding: attached a short README.md to the Drive and included curl/examples in the same folder.

Ownership matrix (single line owners to reduce confusion)
- MOA sign / legal: Asha (BrightWire) & Laura (Redwood Legal)
- Provisioning & access: Vivek (Redwood) / BrightWire infra contact (Tom)
- Test harness uploads & canonical prompts: Tom (BrightWire)
- Evaluation run / metrics gathering: BrightWire eval team (primary) / Rachel (Redwood) (support)
- Final review: Asha + Redwood sales (Priyom + Laura)

Next immediate steps
- Vivek: provision dedicated pool and post credentials by Tue 17 Mar 08:00 PDT.
- Tom: upload the three prompt sets to Drive by Mon 16 Mar 17:00 PDT (if delayed, notify Priyom).
- BrightWire eval: start synthetic baseline run once you have credentials; aim for an initial run within 24 hours of provisioning.

Attachments: small README and the executed MOA (uploaded to Drive).

If anything slips, flag here and we’ll re-align.

Regards,
Priyom

--
Priyom Das

Date: Wed, 18 Mar 2026 10:23:00 -0700
Subject: Quick weekly nudge — trial status check-in

Morning team — small status nudge as we hit mid-trial. Short checklist below (just want to keep momentum):

Status check (please reply with one-line status)
- Credentials provisioned? (Vivek)
- Test harness uploaded? (Tom)
- Initial synthetic run complete? (BrightWire eval)
- Per-route traces available in Console? (Rachel)

What we’ve observed so far (from initial telemetry)
- 95th pctl latency @ 520ms during 5-minute ramp (we’re still tuning batching and KV cache).
- Token cost estimate: ~18% higher than your baseline on small samples.

Immediate next steps
- Vivek: tune batching and enable KV cache persistence for the trial model to aim for sub-350ms 95th pctl.
- Tom/BrightWire eval: run the canonical rerank suite and upload the results CSV to Drive.
- Rachel: share a sample per-route trace CSV after the next 12-hour run.

If any blocker, call me or drop the blocker here. If we can get the synthetic rerun results by EOD Thu we can schedule the quality review Fri.

Thanks — Priyom

--
